propositions: Core implements five CAS retry cycles followed by exactly one conditional terminal push, with strict delivery raising catchable PushDeliveryError and best-effort remaining the default for all existing callers.

Strict mode is additive via keyword-only strict parameter, is translated to process failure only at the Python module adapter boundary, and distinguishes policy declines from transport failures with stable reason codes.

All legacy callers (event append, batch append, NDJSON import, transition close, delete, compact, claim) omit strict or explicitly pass strict=False and retain their established best-effort return/disposition while inheriting the corrected retry budget.
Strict delivery does not write ticket events, does not emit BRIDGE_ALERT, does not call sys.exit from core, and preserves HEAD and working tree state when rejected.
